text:
jules: heads up 0min sync: bench noise from recent 8-bit uploads. want to tighten the intake contracts and add a fast safety gate so we don't waste bench cycles.
priya: saw that too. symptom = intermittent tokenization divergence -> kv-cache misses. reproduces on a tiny seed corpus.
tom: big picture: two fast checks at admit (cheap, deterministic) + one asynchronous deeper check before general promotion. keeps dev velocity but stops noisy models from polluting benchmarks.
rachel: propose cheap admits: verify tokenizer manifest hash, vocab length, and a deterministic encode test using canonical seed set (10 short strings). fail hard if deterministic encode differs.
leo: +1. add a micro-fuzz pass that mutates whitespace/punctuation to catch tokenizer normalization differences. can run in ~200ms per model if we keep seeds small.
priya: operational question: what happens if async check fails after we already routed traffic? options: auto-quarantine to canary pool; or throttle to slowpath until manual triage. we should decide default.
jules: prefer auto-quarantine -> route to canary nodes with isolation and telemetry, then notify owners and allow manual promote after fixes. keeps users safe.
onboard-bot: Admit pipeline job 42133 started for model pkgs/acme-small-8bit. status: started -> running quick-lint.
tom: UX note: registry descriptor should expose a small canonical-bundle URI (not embed the inputs) plus tokenizer manifest url + tokenizer_hash. keep descriptor tiny to avoid registry bloat.
rachel: metrics to add: tokenizer_determinism_failures, kv_cache_hit_delta_pct, quick_lint_ms, async_preflight_status. set page alerts if kv delta > 0.5% or determinism fails > 2 instances in 24h.
leo: implementation plan: 1) quick-lint service (10s SLA) that runs at admit 2) async preflight worker (hourly, retries x3) that runs the full golden suite 3) routing policy change for quarantined models 4) console exposure + auto-tickets to model owner.
priya: policy: block on quick-lint; async-preflight failure -> quarantined + rollback to previous pinned model if traffic had been promoted. we need clear runbooks.
jules: volunteers?
priya: i'll implement the quick-lint + micro-fuzz harness.
tom: i'll wire the descriptor change and the registry migration script.
rachel: i'll add metrics + dashboard panels and hook alerts.
leo: i'll prototype the quarantined routing (canary pool + traffic split) and the console view.
onjboard-bot: (typo) sorry: onboard-bot: queued background preflight job 42133-b. status: queued.
jules: cool. let's aim for a 10-day sprint and a short doc for SRE about failure modes. pairing meeting tomorrow 11:30. :white_check_mark:
